subject: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 8:12 AM
Subject: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

Team — following up on yesterday’s TP hang Sev1 in us-east hosted pool.

We stabilized with traffic shift + capacity drain, but we need to close the loop today on:

1) Runtime fix timeline (what lands in 1.19 hotfix vs later)
- When do we have a candidate with: async error propagation, cancellation/barrier deadlock fix, TP group watchdog/quarantine behavior?
- What’s the canary plan + rollback gates?

2) Customer comms + credits
- Support is getting hit with “when will this be fixed” and “do we get credits” (SUP-9812, SUP-9827 + one enterprise escalation in progress).
- Need consistent messaging: scope, mitigation, ETA, and what we’re offering.

Rafael is updating postmortem action items. Mateo — can you send an owner/timeline for the runtime changes by EOD? Henry/Dev — please align on what we tell customers and whether we proactively offer credits for impacted Dedicated/Enterprise.

Thanks,
Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference


From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 8:34 AM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

Agree this needs a tight plan.

Current thinking for Runtime 1.19.x hotfix (patch):
- Cancellation/barrier deadlock fix (stream disconnect / timeout cancellation): in review now, can land today.
- Collectives async error checks + clearer failure propagation to scheduler: next 1–2 business days (risk: needs careful defaulting).
- TP-group watchdog/quarantine: likely lands in 1.19.x but behind a feature flag default-off for Hosted until canary passes.

Non-hotfix (1.20+):
- Broader scheduler fairness/backpressure improvements and expanded instrumentation.

I’ll send a proper timeline with owners + gates once Sofia/Hiro confirm the PR landing sequence. Connor: we’ll need a go/no-go slot once CI is green.

Mateo


From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 9:03 AM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

Adding what SRE needs for canary/ops guardrails:

Hosted canary gates (must-have):
- Alert: TP watchdog triggers > baseline + any correlated 5xx/timeout spike
- Metric: TP-group reset count, by pool + model
- Dashboard: collective latency p95/p99 (NCCL all-reduce) and per-rank “forward progress” counter
- Rollback trigger: 2+ quarantines per host-hour OR any stuck group that does not recover cleanly

Also, please confirm the failure domain: do we quarantine/reset at TP-group level (preferred) vs host-level (last resort) so oncall has a deterministic playbook.

I’ll update INT-611 to reflect alerting + paging changes (and will route to Allison/Sergio if needed).

Rafael


From: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 9:28 AM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

On customer messaging, proposed language (short + consistent) for Support/CS to use today:

- Summary: “We identified an issue affecting a subset of multi-GPU tensor-parallel workers under sustained load that can lead to requests stalling/timeouts.”
- Mitigation: “We reduced impact via traffic shifts and capacity isolation; we also have configuration mitigations for Dedicated environments if you’re seeing this.”
- Fix: “We’re shipping a patch release with improved cancellation handling and faster surfacing of collective errors, followed by a watchdog/quarantine mechanism.”
- Timeline: “First patch is targeted early next week; watchdog/quarantine follows after canary validation.”

Dev — can you confirm whether we’re offering credits proactively vs case-by-case? I’d rather not over-commit before we know the impacted window per account.

Henry


From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:07 AM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

Re: credits

Support has 3 active threads tied to this pattern, one of which is escalating fast.

Proposal:
- Hosted API: credits case-by-case based on confirmed impact (we can use the incident window + request logs).
- Dedicated/Enterprise: if they had a material customer-visible outage attributable to this issue, we should offer service credits consistent with their SLA (or equivalent goodwill credits if not on SLA).

What I need from SRE today:
- Confirmed incident window (start/end) + impacted regions/pools
- Any accounts you already know were materially impacted (even if unconfirmed)

I can draft a short internal rubric for Support so we don’t debate each ticket in real-time.

Dev


From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:41 AM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

For release coordination:

- I can hold a 30-min go/no-go on Monday 11:00a PT for Runtime 1.19.x hotfix (assuming PRs land + CI passes by EOD today / tomorrow morning).
- Please send me the PR list + risk summary (what’s behind a flag, any config/default changes) so Release can prep rollback plan.

Rafael: if you have hard rollback triggers, send them and we’ll add to the runbook for the canary.

Connor


From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Henry Cho <henry.cho@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 12:06 PM
Subject: Re: TP hang Sev1 (2/13) — follow-ups: runtime timeline + customer comms/credits

Quick answers + next steps:

Incident window (for credits + comms):
- Thu 2/13 14:22–16:05 PT (primary), with tail risk until ~17:00 PT while we drained/shifted.
- Region/pool: us-east hosted “gpu-large” + a smaller spillover into “gpu-standard” for TP-enabled routes.

Dev — I’ll DM you the account list we have from the incident channel + the top SUP tickets so you can draft the rubric.

Henry — your proposed wording works. Please add one line: “No evidence of data exposure; issue was availability/latency only.” (Support keeps getting asked.)

Mateo — request remains: send the specific owner/timeline by EOD with a crisp statement of what’s in 1.19.x vs 1.20, and what’s gated/flagged.

Rafael/Connor — let’s treat Monday go/no-go as the decision point for patch-to-hosted-canary. We need explicit rollback triggers in the release plan.

Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
